module purpose: The module combinationally translates the 16-bit input word instr_i into a 32-bit decoded instruction word on instr_o by extracting bit fields, building immediates, and selecting among decode cases. It also computes an illegal-input decision and uses it to force instr_o(1) low for input patterns marked illegal.

use-case flows.value: 16-bit input encoding expanded into a 32-bit decoded instruction word
illegal-input decision represented by forcing instr_o(1) low

conceptual assets.concept: Decoded 32-bit instruction word assembled from instr_i and driven on instr_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow forms immediate values from instr_i (lines 57-58), initializes decoded (line 62), then under nested case selections on instr_i (lines 65, 68, 106, 170, 211) assigns constant opcode/function fields and copied or rearranged instr_i bits into decoded (for example lines 72-76, 83-87, 115-116, 125-129, 215-220, 251-285). instr_o then takes decoded bits on lines 299-301; the map records decoded SOURCES instr_o at decoded occurrence 104/105/106 and instr_o DERIVES_FROM decoded at instr_o occurrence 2/3/4. Integrity is established because the consumer of instr_o must receive exactly the 32-bit word defined by the selected decode assignments. Availability is also established because the process gives default combinational values at lines 61-62 and overrides them for recognized input patterns.

conceptual assets.concept: Illegal-input decision that qualifies the emitted instruction word
conceptual assets.reasoning: The process sets illegal to '0' by default (line 61) and sets it to '1' for specific input patterns, including lines 77-78, 100, 153-154, 180-181, 203-204, 221-222, 232-246, 256-258, 266-267, and 291. The map records instr_i SELECTS and GATES illegal at those decision points, and illegal GATED_BY or SELECTED_BY instr_i on the corresponding assignments. instr_o(1) is then assigned decoded(1) only when illegal = '0', else '0' (line 300), with instr_o GATED_BY illegal at instr_o occurrence 3. Integrity is established because a wrong illegal decision directly changes the output word delivered on instr_o for the defined input cases. Availability is also established because line 61 always produces a default decision and the listed branches override it combinationally when their conditions hold.
